text: I have heard from area residents about traffic safety concerns on Valentine Drive. Specifically, the speed of vehicles and the danger of crossing the road at Shamokin Drive / Fenelon Drive. Many residents suggested the need for an all-way stop sign at Valentine Drive and Shamokin Drive / Fenelon Drive. There currently exists a two-way stop sign at the intersection, but it has become busy enough to warrant a four way stop.
North York Community Council: 1. Authorized an all-way compulsory stop control at the intersection of Valentine Drive and Shamokin Drive / Fenelon Drive.
